message.content:
Based on my search, here are the PreLicenseTraining login portals:

## Main Student Login
- **URL:** https://prelicensetraining.com/login
- This is the primary login page for students. You'll need your login name (which may be your email address) and password.

## Mentor/Recruiter Login
- **URL:** https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login
- This portal is for mentors, recruiters, and company accounts. If you're a student (not a mentor), there's a link on this page to redirect you to the student login.

## Alternative Mentor Login
- **URL:** https://infinityschools.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login
- Another mentor/recruiter login portal for affiliated schools.

## Forgot Password
- If you need to reset your password, you can use: https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/forgotPassword (for mentor accounts)

**Note:** PreLicenseTraining.com provides insurance pre-licensing and continuing education training with online textbooks, streaming video instruction, audio, practice exams, and a virtual testing center called StudyHall.
